adaptations: Condition text and factual references transcribed from Matterhorn 1.1; notes remain at the source. FreePDF added coverage, review procedures and informative WCAG mappings. No endorsement is implied.
sourceNote: The introduction states 136 conditions and 47 human checks. The 1.1 tables include the added 13-008: 137 conditions, 87 machine, 48 human, and 2 referring to other conditions.
scope: All Matterhorn 1.1 table entries are accounted for. This is an inventory, not a document verdict, a reproduction of ISO standards, or a complete WCAG/ADA checklist.
mappingStatus: WCAG mappings are informative relationships chosen by FreePDF, not equivalence assertions or completed checks. Empty lists mean no direct mapping is claimed.
